FIELDS.NAME: Active Sports Supplies
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Active Sports Supplies is dedicated to providing a wide range of quality sporting goods, including apparel, footwear, and fitness equipment. Our business focuses on non-motorized sporting items to minimize liability exposure. We offer instructional services for low- to moderate-risk sports conducted by certified staff, adhering to strict safety protocols, and ensuring our customers have a safe and enjoyable experience. We maintain robust documentation on product safety recalls and compliance with manufacturer guidelines, and comply with all local, state, and federal safety regulations. Our commitment to customer safety is paramount, and we implement measures such as clear signage and instructions for equipment use. With a focus on risk management and a history of maintaining a low claim rate, we aim to serve our customers while minimizing operational risks.

FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during business hours, alarm system monitored by a central station, and video surveillance throughout the store.

FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Active Sports Supplies carries Workers' Compensation insurance to protect its employees and ensure compliance with legal requirements. This coverage is actively maintained and documented.

FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Active Sports Supplies is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. The business focuses exclusively on retailing non-motorized sporting goods.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Active Sports Supplies does not rent or loan equipment to others as part of its operations, focusing solely on retailing non-motorized sporting goods. This approach helps minimize liability exposure and ensures customer safety.

FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Active Sports Supplies does not have any catastrophe exposure as its operations focus on non-motorized sporting goods, reducing associated risks. The business adheres to safety protocols and complies with all relevant regulations.
